title: Retries with Exponential Backoff & Jitter
learningObjectives: Calculate exponential backoff delays with full jitter: `delay = random(0, min(cap, base * 2^attempt))`
Differentiate retryable transient errors (503, 429, ECONNRESET) from non-retryable errors (400, 401, 404)
Enforce maximum retry attempt limits and overall request deadline timeouts
keyTradeoffs: Full jitter vs decorrelated jitter in reducing synchronized client thundering herds
Retrying inside application services vs delegating to service mesh sidecars (Envoy)
commonPitfalls: Retrying non-idempotent write operations, causing duplicate payments or orders
Retrying without random jitter, creating periodic harmonic spikes on recovering servers
transferPrompt: How do retries coordinate with circuit breakers so repeated failed attempts do not exhaust thread pools?
